_doc: landr-tm48v.1/.2: offer rule fixtures, ONE file for every evaluator. `validity`: is the rule set well-formed (SQL offer_rules_valid == app.models.offers.OfferRules). `matches`: offer_rule_matches(rules, ctx) == expected for SQL, Python (app/services/offer_rules.py) and TS (landr-booking-widget src/lib/offerRules.ts). `keys`: the guest attribute keys a rule set reads (rule_keys / ruleKeys: guest_attr and guest_attr_all, first-use order, deduplicated, malformed sets read none) for Python and TS; a JSON null `rules` stands for SQL NULL. The widget checks in a verbatim copy (src/lib/__fixtures__/offerRules.cases.json); both repos pin this file's sha256 in offer_rules_cases.sha256 -- change both copies and both pins together.
